note: AS-BUILT report set (phase 5). Three deliberately separate surfaces over ONE binding (a session's tmux name): bare /gogo:done ships in chat (board.py + the intent protocol retired; TestNoInteractiveBoardInSkills is the durable guard), S opens modeSessions on the gogo board+drill (adoptRow rows; R re-assigns via the one shared reassign() core; K closes; esc/q to the opener), and /gogo:session-update lets a session rename ITSELF onto the item it is driving (arg -> conversation -> ask; bindAction's cited rule; exact-target rename; writes nothing). before/ carries the plan-time as-is baseline (board-launching done, card-only session ops, the drift with no in-session repair) for the side-by-side compare.
